value.title: Skarsnuten Mountain Resort & Spa i Hemsedal
value.description: Med panoramautsikt over Hemsedal og fjellene finner du Skarsnuten Mountain Resort & Spa. Nyt oppholdet med god mat og drikke i herlige omgivelser.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Skarsnuten Mountain Resort & Spa
				
Velkommen til toppen av Hemsedal
Velkommen til toppen av Hemsedal
Skarsnuten venter på deg, 1002 moh. 
Nyt utsikten, opplevelsene og velværet – helt på kanten …
								
Skarsnuten Exclusive
18. - 20. september, 2026
Skarsnuten er stengt grunnet et privat arrangement fra kl. 17.00 fredag 18. september til kl. 13.00 søndag 20. september.
Restauranten, spaet og hotellet er stengt for eksterne gjester.
Åpningstider - Høst 2026
				
Fra 1. juli – 1. august har vi sommeråpent hver dag!
Fra august – desember har Skarsnuten åpent onsdager til søndager.
Restaurant Lynx åpner kl. 17:00 på onsdager og stenger etter frokost på søndager.
Spa-avdelingen åpner kl. 13:00 på onsdager og stenger kl. 12:30 på søndager.
NB! større grupper eller konferanser kan booke utenfor disse åpningstider
Fra desember holder vi åpent alle dager i uken gjennom hele vintersesongen.
Velkommen til fjells!
Dette vil du ikke gå glipp av i høst!
Fri Flyt Film Tour - fredag 2. okt
Smaksfestivalen - lørdag 3. okt 2026
Pakker & Tilbud
Spa - with a view
Pelsdekket komfort
Skiers’ Office
Hotellrom
På Skarsnuten Mountain Resort & Spa har vi 4 forskjellige romtyper fordelt på 88 rom. Enkeltrom, dobbeltrom, deluxerom og suiter. Rommene på hotellet har utsikt over Hemsedal den ene veien, og skisenteret den andre veien. Alle rommene har godt med plass, skrivebord og stort bad med såper fra Loccitane og kaffemaskin fra Costa.
Bar & Restaurant
Restaurant Lynx på Skarsnuten har en koselig og privat atmosfære med spennende arkitektur og utsikt. Her serveres frokost buffet, lunsj og middag (a-la-carte meny) til hotellgjester og andre besøkende.
Spis i majestetiske omgivelser med Hemsedals beste utsikt!
Vi tilbyr to forskjellige restauranter på Skarsnuten – Lynx og Miru.
Lynx – Restauranten har en koselig og privat atmosfære med spennende arkitektur og utsikt. Her serveres frokost buffet, lunsj og middag (a-la-carte meny) til hotellgjester og andre besøkende.
Miru 見る – Her serverer vi tradisjonelle japanske smaker med et moderne, nordisk preg. Miru betyr «å se» på japansk, og tilbyr en fantastisk utsikt over den vakre fjellene.
Spis i majestetiske omgivelser med Hemsedals beste utsikt!
Spa & Behandlinger
Sammen med venner, kjæresten, familien, jobben – eller alene – nyter du gode opplevelser og fantastisk utsikt. Enten du velger en av saunaene, fotbadene, opplevelsesdusjene, jacuzzien eller iskulpen, garanterer vi senkede skuldre og påfyll av energi.
Konferanser, seminar og møter
Skarsnuten Mountain Resort & Spa er det perfekte stedet for ditt arrangement, enten det er privat eller med bedriften. Lei hele, eller deler av hotellet, og få en skreddersydd opplevelse med alt dere ønsker dere, med våre 88 hotellrom er det mange muligheter. Vi har også velværeavdeling, kinosal, og møterom med flott utsikt. Restauranten er selvfølgelig med i planleggingen, og sørger for at maten og drikken også blir uforglemmelig.
Vil dere fylle fritiden med spennende opplevelser er det ikke noe problem. Fortell oss hva dere ønsker å gjøre, så ordner vi opplegget for dere.
Parkering & elbillader
Parkering utenfor hotellet
2 timer gratis. Deretter kr 17,50 per time eller kr 115 per døgn.
Parkering i hotellets garasje
2 timer gratis. Deretter kr 17,50 per time eller kr 170 per døgn.
Lade elbil ved hotellet?
Vi har 14 stk. ladestasjoner for elbil, 4 stk., utenfor hotellet og 10 stk. i parkeringsgarasjen. PlugPay ladestasjon med betaling.
NB! Egen ladekabel benyttes.
Siste nytt
Vår populære smaksfestival er tilbake for fjerde gang og vi gleder oss til å invitere deg til en dag fylt med gode smaker og spennende opplevelser! Bli med på en kulinarisk reise gjennom et mangfold av delikatesser, fra lokale spesialiteter til internasjonale favoritter. Opplev en eksplosjon av smaker og la deg overvelde av gode viner, øl, cider, oster og andre spennende smaker. Dette er en unik anledning til å utforske nye favoritter og få inspirasjon til å lage egen gastronomi hjemme.
Snøen er kanskje ikke her helt ennå – men vinterfølelsen kommer tidlig til Skarsnuten. Fredag 2. oktober fyller Fri Flyt Film Tour huset med rå skikjøring, store fjellopplevelser og filmer som får det til å krible i skibeina. Dette blir høstens møteplass for alle som allerede teller ned til vinteren.
Vinsmaking og vinterkvelder = en veldig koselig kombinasjon! Bli med på en minneverdig vinopplevelse hos oss, hver fredag hele vinteren! Velkommen til Vinoteket kl 17:00. Dette er veldig gøy! Tips en venn, og bli med! Vi ser frem til å skape uforglemmelige smaksminner sammen med deg!

pages.title: Kontakt oss - Skarsnuten Hotel
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Veibeskrivelse
Har du problemer med å finne fram? Ring oss…
Ta avkjørselen til Hemsedal Skisenter. Sving deretter til høyre i krysset etter broen. Følg veien oppover, hold til venstre og fortsett oppover langs skibakken. Hold til venstre i krysset ved Veslestølen, og etter Tindenheisen følger du skiltene og svinger til høyre inn til Skarsnuten Hotel.
Bakken opp fra skisenteret er ca 3 km lang.
Du kan finne veien til oss ved å skrive inn GPS koordinatene våre (60.862304, 8.490758).
Det er en automatisk digital bomløsning i bakken – du får kode i resepsjonen, som gir overnattingsgjester gratis passering.
Som en del av våres miljøpolicy oppfodrer vi til og reise kollektivt.
https://hemsedal.com/transport
Velkommen!
Åpningstider
SKARSNUTEN MOUNTAIN RESORT & SPA
Vinter sesong: Åpent hver dag.
Maj – juni: Åpent onsdag – søndag
Juli: Sommeråpent hver dag

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Skarsnuten Hotel Google profile: rating 4.3/5, 824 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
We had an excellent stay. The summer views over the Hemsedal Valley are absolutely breathtaking, and the peaceful surroundings make it the perfect place to relax.

The rooms are modern, clean, and very comfortable. The spa area is a real highlight: both the indoor and outdoor jacuzzis offer stunning panoramic views of the valley. There is also a traditional dry sauna, a steam sauna, and a cold plunge pool, creating a complete wellness experience.

The restaurant also deserves special praise. The service was impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who made us feel welcome throughout our stay.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for peace, beautiful nature, spectacular views, and outstanding service. We will definitely be back.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
If you're considering this hotel, this is your sign to just do it.

What a gem. The feeling of luxury is everywhere. Beautiful rooms, super comfortable bed, even four different types of pillows to choose from!

The spa is varied, with multiple hot tubs, a cold plunge, a dry sauna and a steamy one. They make you book a time in advance, so the spa doesn't get too crowded.

Breakfast was standard continental, with a sprinkle of Norwegian goodies.

The view is also absolutely breathtaking.

Lastly, all the staff I've met have been super friendly and I really, really enjoyed my stay here.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Wonderful food, views, and friendly attentive staff. They make you feel at home. The spa offered to guests is unmatched.  Two saunas, indoor and outdoor hottubs, pools, cold plunge. Our room was so cozy and beautiful.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
The location of the hotel is truly beautiful and unique, offering an exceptional view. The spa area is very tastefully designed and is a wonderful place to relax and unwind.

A major highlight is the small outdoor area with the infinity jacuzzi and infinity pool. The view from there is simply priceless.

The room itself was excellent, and everything felt very high-quality. It was cozy, comfortable, and extremely well equipped. I would especially like to highlight the attention to detail in the room amenities. The high-quality soap and shampoo, lovely bathrobes, and other thoughtful touches really added to the overall experience.

Unfortunately, I noticed quite a few animal hairs on my bedspread. This was a little unpleasant and did bother me, although it did not significantly affect my overall stay. The sheets and the bed itself were clean.

What I found disappointing, however, was how my concern was handled when I mentioned it to the staff. I would have appreciated a more understanding and accommodating response — for example, a simple apology and perhaps a small gesture of goodwill to compensate for the inconvenience, such as covering the parking fee. This would be a fairly stand

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
I just stayed here with my parents, each in our own room. The staff was excellent, from the girl at the reception to the people working in the restaurant (a few names I remember are Federico, Aleksandra and Edmundz). We stayed for four nights and each night the food was very delicious and, we were exceptionally well treated and so was our little dog :)

Also the tall friendly girl working in the kitchen in the morning was superprofessional helping out with requests regarding food preferences and allergies. So did the people working at dinner.

My dad thought the bed was too soft but other than that all was great. Very clean rooms and friendly people working in all parts of the hotel.

Also the location is very beautiful.

Thank you so much for a very pleasant stay

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Veibeskrivelse
Har du problemer med å finne fram? Ring oss…
Ta avkjørselen til Hemsedal Skisenter. Sving deretter til høyre i krysset etter broen. Følg veien oppover, hold til venstre og fortsett oppover langs skibakken. Hold til venstre i krysset ved Veslestølen, og etter Tindenheisen følger du skiltene og svinger til høyre inn til Skarsnuten Hotel.
Bakken opp fra skisenteret er ca 3 km lang.
Du kan finne veien til oss ved å skrive inn GPS koordinatene våre (60.862304, 8.490758).
Det er en automatisk digital bomløsning i bakken – du får kode i resepsjonen, som gir overnattingsgjester gratis passering.
Som en del av våres miljøpolicy oppfodrer vi til og reise kollektivt.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
We had an excellent stay. The summer views over the Hemsedal Valley are absolutely breathtaking, and the peaceful surroundings make it the perfect place to relax.

The rooms are modern, clean, and very comfortable. The spa area is a real highlight: both the indoor and outdoor jacuzzis offer stunning panoramic views of the valley. There is also a traditional dry sauna, a steam sauna, and a cold plunge pool, creating a complete wellness experience.

The restaurant also deserves special praise. The service was impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who made us feel welcome throughout our stay.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for peace, beautiful nature, spectacular views, and outstanding service. We will definitely be back.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
If you're considering this hotel, this is your sign to just do it.

What a gem. The feeling of luxury is everywhere. Beautiful rooms, super comfortable bed, even four different types of pillows to choose from!

The spa is varied, with multiple hot tubs, a cold plunge, a dry sauna and a steamy one. They make you book a time in advance, so the spa doesn't get too crowded.

Breakfast was standard continental, with a sprinkle of Norwegian goodies.

The view is also absolutely breathtaking.

Lastly, all the staff I've met have been super friendly and I really, really enjoyed my stay here.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Wonderful food, views, and friendly attentive staff. They make you feel at home. The spa offered to guests is unmatched.  Two saunas, indoor and outdoor hottubs, pools, cold plunge. Our room was so cozy and beautiful.

external_observations.evidence_span:
The location of the hotel is truly beautiful and unique, offering an exceptional view. The spa area is very tastefully designed and is a wonderful place to relax and unwind.

A major highlight is the small outdoor area with the infinity jacuzzi and infinity pool. The view from there is simply priceless.

The room itself was excellent, and everything felt very high-quality. It was cozy, comfortable, and extremely well equipped. I would especially like to highlight the attention to detail in the room amenities. The high-quality soap and shampoo, lovely bathrobes, and other thoughtful touches really added to the overall experience.

Unfortunately, I noticed quite a few animal hairs on my bedspread. This was a little unpleasant and did bother me, although it did not significantly affect my overall stay. The sheets and the bed itself were clean.

What I found disappointing, however, was how my concern was handled when I mentioned it to the staff. I would have appreciated a more understanding and accommodating response — for example, a simple apology and perhaps a small gesture of goodwill to compensate for the inconvenience, such as covering the parking fee. I just stayed here with my parents, each in our own room. The staff was excellent, from the girl at the reception to the people working in the restaurant (a few names I remember are Federico, Aleksandra and Edmundz). We stayed for four nights and each night the food was very delicious and, we were exceptionally well treated and so was our little dog :)

Also the tall friendly girl working in the kitchen in the morning was superprofessional helping out with requests regarding food preferences and allergies. So did the people working at dinner.

My dad thought the bed was too soft but other than that all was great. Very clean rooms and friendly people working in all parts of the hotel.

Also the location is very beautiful.

Thank you so much for a very pleasant stay
